requirements.title: Book Art Presets and Print Preparation
requirements.description: Five deterministic book-art presets declare prompt and negative blocks, canvas size, steps, seed defaults, and ordered post-steps; the deterministic print_prep op resamples a trim box, tags DPI and reports binary ink coverage. A saved multi-op recipe remains pending.

validation.notes: Contract implemented in the capability manifest and print_prep compute operation; automatic preset→upscale→print_prep replay remains unimplemented.
